title: Reception of the RRCRelease by the UE

entities.name: RRCRelease message
entities.description: Message sent by the network to release the RRC connection, potentially including configuration for RRC_INACTIVE state or redirection information.

entities.name: Timer T380
entities.description: Timer related to RRC connection release procedures.

entities.name: Timer T320
entities.description: Timer for cell reselection priority information validity.

entities.name: Timer T316
entities.description: Timer related to connection re-establishment procedures.

entities.name: Timer T350
entities.description: Timer used in RRC connection management.

entities.name: Timer T346g
entities.description: Timer used in RRC connection management.

entities.name: AS security not activated
entities.description: Condition where access stratum security is not active, affecting how the UE processes the RRCRelease message.

entities.name: RRC_IDLE state
entities.description: RRC state where the UE is not connected to the network.

entities.name: RRC_INACTIVE state
entities.description: RRC state where the UE maintains some context but is not actively communicating.

entities.name: suspendConfig
entities.description: Configuration included in RRCRelease to suspend the RRC connection and transition to RRC_INACTIVE state.

entities.name: redirectedCarrierInfo
entities.description: Information element indicating carrier redirection, potentially to E-UTRA.

entities.name: cellReselectionPriorities
entities.description: Information element providing cell reselection priority information.

entities.name: waitTime
entities.description: Time value used for access barring procedures.

relations.description: RRCRelease message stops timer T380 if running.
RRCRelease message stops timer T320 if running.
RRCRelease message stops timer T316 if running.
RRCRelease message stops timer T350 if running.
RRCRelease message stops timer T346g if running.
When AS security is not activated, UE transitions to RRC_IDLE state.
RRCRelease message may contain suspendConfig information element.
Presence of suspendConfig leads to transition to RRC_INACTIVE state.
RRCRelease message may contain redirectedCarrierInfo for E-UTRA redirection.
RRCRelease message may contain cellReselectionPriorities information.
RRCRelease message may contain waitTime information element.
When t320 is included, UE starts timer T320 with the provided value.
